notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
Hi! As I mentioned earlier, I’ve just released a major content update. There are three new levels to explore, the story continues with new developments, and I’ve also added many small improvements throughout the game. Additionally, the combat system has been refined to make every fight feel more satisfying. I’d love for you to give it a try — I really hope you’ll enjoy what I’ve been working on!



Stay in touch!
Anton Basan



P.S.

And as always, I will be very grateful for feedback on bugs found and general opinions about the game and its components. Your feedback helps me make this game better!

Discord server for feedback and just chatting: https://discord.gg/nukpZqsY

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
Hi, I'm happy to announce that I'm back in development! I'm currently releasing a small patch, but I'm already working on a larger content update with new levels and a continuation of the story. I plan to finish it in the near future, so stay tuned!

At the moment, the following issues have been fixed:

The player can get stuck in the Caves

The game freezes after dying with the Inventory open

Walking SFX is being played over the Dialogues

The Player is invincible after reaching 100% of the Rage stat

Quest Items cannot be picked up if the Inventory is full

Various Inventory UI bugs

Unrecognizable or too quiet SFX


Stay in touch!
Anton Basan

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello! I've fixed the following problems reported by players: 

 The Game is now more balanced 

 Collectibles work properly 

 The dash exploit does not work anymore 

 The color inversion effect is softer 


Stay in touch!
Anton Basan
